podcast-dannyjones-8BstHzjJT0w:
Gary Wayne has written large books arguing that the Bible's Nephilim, the giants of Genesis, left traces in bloodlines and secret societies that persist today. With Danny Jones, he connects that thesis to the Knights Templar, the Rothschild family, and his account of the true Satan as a literal, active being.

Wayne builds his case from scripture, genealogy, and the occult histories he has catalogued for years. Jones follows the chain link by link. The claims stand far outside mainstream scholarship and are kept here as Wayne presents them, without endorsement. For listeners drawn to biblical conspiracy literature, the episode is a concentrated dose of its most systematic author, making his full argument in conversation rather than in the footnotes of his books.
podcast-tuckercarlson-f2ABq3UCN0w:
Doctor Mark Hyman joins Tucker Carlson as his friend Robert F. Kennedy Jr. nears a top health post. Hyman never thought he would see this moment. He calls it historic for American health.

He says the nation grew sicker like a frog in warming water. Health costs now near five trillion dollars a year. Most of that spending, he argues, treats illness that food could prevent. The title blames toxic food and drug firms that profit. The episode lays out a food-first cure from a doctor inside the reform push.
